SQL:
SELECT n.node_id,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM node_label l WHERE l.node_id=n.node_id AND l.label='Tdoc') AS is_Tdoc,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM node_label l WHERE l.node_id=n.node_id AND l.label='CR') AS is_CR,
        coalesce(t.tdocNumber,cr.tdocNumber) AS tdocNumber,
        coalesce(t.type,cr.type) AS type,
        coalesce(t.id,cr.id) AS id,
        coalesce(t.title,cr.title) AS title
        FROM node n LEFT JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=n.node_id LEFT JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=n.node_id
        WHERE t.node_id IS NOT NULL OR cr.node_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY n.node_id
